resolution_notes: Settled base_url against current official sources. UK Parliament publishes a family of separate subdomain APIs (members-api, bills-api, committees-api, etc.), not one single base. https://members-api.parliament.uk/api is a real, operational Members API root (Swagger at members-api.parliament.uk; example Search works), and the entry’s description already frames this as a family. Verifier B’s “incorrect” without a correction is weaker than that live evidence; keeping members-api as the representative base_url is justified for a multi-service open-data family when no single umbrella API host exists. All other fields left null (keep original).
